subject: Arte
description_pt: Investigar e experimentar diferentes funções teatrais e discutir os limites e desafios do trabalho artístico coletivo e colaborativo.

components.description_pt: Investigar diferentes papéis teatrais como ator, diretor e dramaturgo
components.description_en: Investigate different theatrical roles such as actor, director, and playwright
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate specific choices a director or actor makes in adapting a story or drama

components.description_pt: Experimentar diferentes papéis teatrais na prática
components.description_en: Experiment with performing different theatrical roles in practice

components.description_pt: Discutir desafios e limites do trabalho artístico coletivo e colaborativo no teatro
components.description_en: Discuss challenges and limits of collective and collaborative artistic work in theater

cc_matches.description: Analyze the extent to which a filmed or live production of a story or drama stays faithful to or departs from the text or script, evaluating the choices made by the director or actors.
